description: Live truck GPS: create loads, read position, ETA, driver state, trip stats. API key or USDC x402.
name: io.github.sudzikcoin/pingpoint

environmentVariables.description: PingPoint Agent API key (sup_agent_...), issued in the cabinet: Integrations -> Agent API. Either this or PINGPOINT_WALLET_KEY_FILE.
environmentVariables.name: PINGPOINT_AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Pay per call with USDC (x402) instead of a key: path to a file holding the wallet key - EVM private key (0x + 64 hex) for arc-testnet/base-mainnet, solana-keygen JSON or base58 secret for solana-mainnet. Either this or PINGPOINT_AGENT_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: PINGPOINT_WALLET_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Network for wallet mode: arc-testnet (default), base-mainnet or solana-mainnet (arc-mainnet once USDC on Arc mainnet is published)
environmentVariables.name: PINGPOINT_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Override for the PingPoint API base URL (default https://api.suverse.io with a key, https://pingpoint.suverse.io with a wallet)
environmentVariables.name: PINGPOINT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Wallet mode only: JSON-RPC URL of the chosen chain for get_balance and, on Solana, the blockhash read each payment needs (default: the public RPC, which rate-limits)
environmentVariables.name: PINGPOINT_RPC_URL
